title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (November, 2025)
summary: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central released November 2025 cumulative updates across multiple versions (BC27, BC26, BC25, BC24) with version 27.1 for 2025 wave 2 introducing flexible environment management in the Admin Center. The post provides version numbers, release dates, and lifecycle support information for all active and end-of-life versions.
key_points: BC27.1 (2025 wave 2) is now available with flexible environment management capabilities in the Admin Center
BC25 (2024 wave 2) now offers flexible major updates (extended from 30/60 days to 5 months) and optional minor updates
Multiple versions released: BC27 CU01, BC26 CU07, BC25 CU13, and BC24 CU18 (end of life)
BC27 support runs from October 1, 2025 to April 6, 2027 under the Modern Lifecycle Policy
Comprehensive lifecycle information provided for versions BC14 through BC27 with specific start and retirement dates
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in Admin Center

quotes.text: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center
quotes.why_it_matters: This new capability in BC27.1 allows better control over SaaS environments, improving operational flexibility

quotes.text: Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: BC25 now provides extended update windows, giving customers more time to plan and test updates before mandatory deployment
